ideas.title: Roll for Nests
ideas.hook: Roll a giant die and hop around a board of bird nests. Land on a nest and you take its egg home to hatch.
core_loop: Roll the die to move around a looping board of nests
Land on a nest to grab its egg (rarer nests sit on harder-to-hit tiles)
Hatch eggs on your plot into pets that boost roll power
Buy die upgrades that add extra faces and reroll charges
ideas.twist: Land on the same tile as another player and you both roll off; the higher roll takes the other's egg.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards is at 2.59× momentum with [🎉 UPD 7] Anime Dice holding 54.7K CCU at 55 days, and eggs is the most crowded rising theme (1.22×, 38 young games, 318.7K CCU). Dice × eggs is the top gap in the data (score 8.91), and the "___ for ___" title formula is the fastest-rising name pattern at 3.86×.
ideas.differentiator: Anime Dice rolls straight for a reward; here the roll moves you on a shared board, so luck, position and other players all matter.

ideas.title: Forge for Anime Blades
ideas.hook: Hammer raw ore into anime-style blades. Every strike adds +1 power, and a fully forged blade unlocks its own special attack.
core_loop: Mine ore in zone worlds and haul it to your anvil
Hammer the blade: each hit is +1 sharpness
Quench with fire, ice or lightning to set the blade's element
Take the blade into boss arenas and earn rarer ore
ideas.twist: Blades level from use: the more bosses a blade beats, the more it evolves, so two players with the same recipe end up with different swords.
retention: Blade index with every element combo
ideas.why_now: Forge × anime is the #4 gap (score 7.25). Forge/craft is rising at 1.76× led by [BOSS]+1 Loot To Forge (37.8K CCU at 58 days), the anime theme is at 1.56× (Anime Breaker [🏰TOWER] 12.4K), and anime art is the only big art style still rising (1.11×, 12 young games).
ideas.differentiator: +1 Loot To Forge forges loot you already found; here the forging itself is the game and each blade grows its own moveset.

ideas.title: Diggers VS Zombies
ideas.hook: By day you dig trenches and tunnels around your base. At night zombies come and fall into whatever you dug.
core_loop: Dig trenches, pits and tunnels with your shovel during the day
Find ores while digging and spend them on traps and better shovels
Survive the night as zombies walk into your pits
Each night survived makes the next horde bigger and the rewards richer
ideas.twist: Dig too deep and you break into an underground zombie nest: huge rewards, but the horde comes up early.
retention: Offline ore from your mine shaft
ideas.why_now: Break/mine/dig is the top rising mechanic at 3.15× (Break and Steal an Egg at 124.4K CCU in 34 days), zombies is rising at 1.34× (Build and Kill Zombies, 14.6K), and dig × zombies is the #5 gap (score 6.85). "___ vs ___" titles are at 2.12× (Ball VS Ball, 29.8K).
ideas.differentiator: Build and Kill Zombies has you build walls; here the ground itself is your weapon, so every defense is a hole you dug.

ideas.title: Chisel for Cash
ideas.hook: Chip away at a block of stone to carve a statue. The closer it matches the order, the more the buyer pays.
core_loop: Pick an order card (a duck, a crown, a noob face)
Chip the stone block with your chisel to shape it
Sell the statue to the buyer; better match, bigger payout
Buy rarer stone (marble, gold, crystal) worth more per statue
ideas.twist: Hidden gems sit inside some blocks. Chip in the right spot and the statue sparkles for a 10x sale.
ideas.why_now: Stones/ores is the fastest-rising theme at 2.8× (+1 Stone Skipping 35.4K, Lift Rock For Eggs 8.5K), money is at 2.16×, and paint/create is rising at 1.54× (Paint to Get Rich [MUSEUM] 🎨, 13.5K CCU). Paint × stones is a top-10 gap (score 6.22).
ideas.differentiator: Paint to Get Rich paints flat canvases; here you carve 3D statues out of stone, and the block can hide a gem.

ideas.title: Paint for Eggs
ideas.hook: Paint a blank egg any way you like. The colours and patterns you use decide what hatches out.
core_loop: Grab a blank egg and paint it with your brushes
Hatch it: colour mix sets the pet's element, coverage sets rarity
Pets earn coins on your plot
Unlock new paints (glow, rainbow, gold) to hatch rarer pets
ideas.twist: Each day one secret colour combo hatches a mythic. Players can paint and trade 'recipe' eggs to share the hunt.
ideas.why_now: Paint × eggs is an open gap (score 5.30). Eggs is the biggest rising theme (1.22×, 38 young games, 318.7K CCU), paint/create is at 1.54× (Paint to Get Rich [MUSEUM] 🎨 13.5K, [🎨] Hide In Pixels 3.1K at 14 days), and "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.86× (Drill for Eggs 13.8K).
ideas.differentiator: Other egg games hand you random eggs; here you make the egg, so the hatch feels earned and players share recipes.

ideas.title: Roll for Drip
ideas.hook: Roll dice to get random clothing pieces, then style what you rolled and walk the runway to get rated.
core_loop: Roll three dice: top, bottom and accessory
Keep or reroll pieces before the timer ends
Walk the runway while players vote
Win coins to unlock rarer dice (designer, glow, mythic)
ideas.twist: Roll triples and you get a full matching set that instantly scores bonus points with the judges.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards is at 2.59× (Anime Dice 54.7K) and fashion is rising at 1.28× with fresh hits Makeup Mania! BETA [LASH TECH UPDATE] (10.6K CCU at 14 days) and Dress Designer (5.1K at 15 days). Dice × fashion is an open gap (score 5.61).
ideas.differentiator: Dress-up games let you pick anything; here luck picks the pieces and skill is making a random outfit work.

ideas.title: +1 Bass Drop
ideas.hook: Tap on the beat to get +1 bass. Drop the bass and the blast launches everyone on the dance floor.
core_loop: Tap in time with the music: every hit is +1 bass
Drop the bass to launch dancers and earn coins by distance
Buy bigger speakers and new tracks
Rebirth to unlock new stages in new worlds
ideas.twist: Perfect streaks stack a combo; hit 100 in a row and your drop shakes the whole server.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat is rising at 2.72× ([BOSS]+1 Loot To Forge 37.8K, +1 Stone Skipping 35.4K) and "+1 ___" titles are at 2.99×. Music/dance is rising at 1.2× (💃[Disco dance] Trending Emote Dance 3.6K, [UPD] Aura Dance Battles 🔥 2.6K), and +1 × music is an open gap (score 5.01).
ideas.differentiator: Music games on Roblox are rhythm or dance-off; this turns rhythm into a +1 grind with a big physical payoff.

ideas.title: Dig for Shelter
ideas.hook: A storm is coming. Dig down as fast as you can, because the deeper your shelter, the more you survive.
core_loop: A storm warning starts a countdown
Dig a shelter under your plot and collect ores on the way
Survive the storm; deeper rooms protect more of your loot
Spend ores on better drills before the next storm
ideas.twist: Storms change each round: tornado, flood, meteor. Floods fill deep holes, so going deepest isn't always the answer.
monetization: Storm radar pass (see the next storm early)
ideas.why_now: Break/mine/dig leads all mechanics at 3.15× (Break and Steal an Egg 124.4K, Drill for Eggs 13.8K at 23 days, Dig For Eggs 7.9K), and dig × disaster is an open gap (score 5.88). Interiors are a rising map style at 1.22×.
ideas.differentiator: Dig games reward depth for loot; here depth is also survival, and the storm type changes which depth is safe.

ideas.title: Build a Scrap Kart
ideas.hook: Weld junk into a kart, race it, then use the winnings to forge better parts.
core_loop: Collect scrap parts around the junkyard world
Forge parts at your workbench: engines, wheels, boosters
Race your kart on server tracks for cash
Unlock new worlds with tougher tracks and rarer scrap
ideas.twist: Every part you forge rolls random stats, and karts that crash drop a part other racers can grab.
ideas.why_now: Forge/craft is rising at 1.76× ([BOSS]+1 Loot To Forge 37.8K) and vehicles at 1.22× (Firefighting Sim 🚒 17.3K at 17 days, Steal A Car 7.3K). Forge × vehicles is an open gap (score 5.08), and "Build a ___" titles are rising at 1.23× (Build the Pyramid! 11.9K).
ideas.differentiator: Car games hand you finished cars; here you craft every part, so each kart is unique and the garage is the progression.

ideas.title: Burrow for Loot
ideas.hook: Everyone's base has a vault. Dig tunnels underground to break into other players' vaults from below.
core_loop: Build your base and vault that earns cash over time
Dig tunnels underground toward rival bases
Break into their vault from below and run back with the loot
Reinforce your floor so nobody tunnels into yours
ideas.twist: Tunnels stay open. Anyone can follow your tunnel, so a raid route can be turned against you.
ideas.why_now: Dig + steal is a proven pair (Break and Steal an Egg at 124.4K CCU, 34 days old) with only 2 young games in it, and hatch + steal is the biggest young pair (19 games, 225.2K CCU). Money theme is at 2.16× (Steal From The Rich! 10.3K) and personal plots are a rising map style at 1.16×.
ideas.differentiator: Steal games make you run in through the front; here every raid is a tunnel from below, so base defense is about your floor, not your door.
